name: meerkat
description: Coordinate local development, review and polish with frozen tasks, private history and a live agent monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate bounded development, review and polish runs with a live agent monitor.
interface.longDescription: Choose direct coordinator work, one delegated run or a development/review/polish workflow. Delegated tasks use frozen context, profiles and linked Git worktrees. The current executor is Pi. Go owns scheduling and process control; SQLite stores history and measured usage. The standard MCP Apps panel shows Agents, Tasks and Usage, with bounded instructions, pause, follow-up, receipt queries and stop controls. Delivery is a locally reviewed commit; QA, human acceptance and deployment are separate. See repository verification records for current host and installation evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose a suitable execution path for this requirement: direct coordinator work, one bounded delegated run, or a full Meerkat workflow. For delegation, freeze the scope, context and profiles, prepare a linked worktree, then report the local commit, checks and known gaps.
